name: nipopow-mixed
description: The nipopow-mixed scenario (a NiPoPoW-bootstrapping joiner on one jar against serving peers on the other jar, both directions; same script, same result name) with the opposite expectation (EXPECT=applied): for a candidate whose proofs the base accepts and which accepts the base's, a run passes when the joiner applies the served proof and rejects none (`pass`, the hook's own PASS), in both arms.
